newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin, Chernomyrdin to meet at 0900 GMT.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin, Chernomyrdin to meet at 0900 GMT.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin, recovering from major heart surgery, will meet Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin at noon (0900 GMT) on Tuesday, the government press service said.

A press service spokesman gave no other details. Russian news agencies said the two men were expected to discuss political and economic issues, including efforts to improve Russia's dismal record on tax collection.

An emergency commission looking at the tax issue was due to meet later on Tuesday. The commission, chaired by Chernomyrdin, has already said it will start bankruptcy proceedings against major tax debtors.
Yeltsin, 65, is expected to move to a government rest home in the next few days to continue his recuperation from the quintuple bypass operation which he had on November 5.
A Russian newspaper published the first post-operation pictures of the president at the weekend. Yeltsin, shown drinking tea with his wife and granddaughter, was smiling and looked relaxed.
